name: Mireille Lowell
source:
Mireille was a foundling who grew up in one of the many orphanages within House Utica's domain. Showing an aptitude for subterfuge from a young age, Mireille was assigned to Utica's vassal House Seidel to officially begin her training for a life in espionage.

A top-ranking agent, Mireille is a master of infiltration, thievery, and assassination. Mireille possesses cunning mind, heightened perception and a deep understanding of human behavior. She frequently employs psychological tricks and manipulation as her best tools for any mission.

After House Seidel's fall on the Day of Infamy, Mireille was taken in by House Utica, and was recently called upon to represent their interest in SOS Nu.

[spoiler]Mireille was off-duty by the orders of Lord Eduard of Seidel during the Day of Infamy attacks. Unable to contribute in the defence of her house, Mireille has struggled with her failure ever since.

An exemplary professional, Mireille has set strict personal boundaries when it comes to matters involving spy craft. However, these limits have loosened up considerably since her prime. Now determined to regain her honor, Mireille will go where her past self never would to complete the mission at hand.[/spoiler]

[In-Game Description]
